mapper.sql: id, user_id, equipment_id, request_type, requested_quantity, purpose, urgency, expected_start_date, expected_end_date, status, admin_id, processed_at, decision_reason, priority_score, created_at, updated_at

sr.id, sr.user_id, sr.equipment_id, sr.request_type, sr.requested_quantity, sr.purpose, sr.urgency, sr.expected_start_date, sr.expected_end_date, sr.status, sr.admin_id, sr.processed_at, sr.decision_reason, sr.priority_score, sr.created_at, sr.updated_at, u.name as user_name, u.username as user_username, e.name as equipment_name, e.category as equipment_category, r.name as reviewer_name
LEFT JOIN users u ON sr.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN equipment e ON sr.equipment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN users r ON sr.admin_id = r.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO special_rental_requests ( user_id, equipment_id, request_type, requested_quantity, current_available_quantity, current_user_rental_count, purpose, urgency, expected_start_date, expected_end_date, status, priority_score ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{equipmentId}, #{requestType}, #{requestedQuantity}, #{currentAvailableQuantity}, #{currentUserRentalCount}, #{purpose}, #{urgencyLevel}, #{expectedStartDate}, #{expectedEndDate}, #{status}, #{priorityScore} )
mapper.select: SELECT sr.id, sr.user_id, sr.equipment_id, sr.request_type, sr.requested_quantity, sr.current_available_quantity, sr.current_user_rental_count, sr.purpose, sr.urgency, sr.expected_start_date, sr.expected_end_date, sr.status, sr.priority_score, sr.admin_id, sr.decision_reason, sr.processed_at, sr.created_at, sr.updated_at, u.name as user_name, u.username as user_username, e.name as equipment_name, e.category as equipment_category, r.name as reviewer_name FROM special_rental_requests sr LEFT JOIN users u ON sr.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN equipment e ON sr.equipment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN users r ON sr.admin_id = r.id WHERE sr.id = #{id}

SELECT sr.id, sr.user_id, sr.equipment_id, sr.request_type, sr.requested_quantity, sr.purpose, sr.urgency, sr.expected_start_date, sr.expected_end_date, sr.status, sr.priority_score, sr.admin_id, sr.decision_reason, sr.processed_at, sr.created_at, sr.updated_at, u.name as user_name, u.username as user_username, e.name as equipment_name, e.category as equipment_category, r.name as reviewer_name FROM special_rental_requests sr LEFT JOIN users u ON sr.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN equipment e ON sr.equipment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN users r ON sr.admin_id = r.id WHERE sr.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY CASE WHEN sr.urgency = 'EMERGENCY' THEN 1 WHEN sr.urgency = 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN sr.urgency = 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, sr.priority_score DESC, sr.created_at ASC
LIMIT #{params.offset}, #{params.size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM special_rental_requests sr WHERE sr.status = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE special_rental_requests SET status = 'APPROVED', admin_id = #{reviewedBy}, processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, decision_reason = #{approvalReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE special_rental_requests SET status = 'REJECTED', admin_id = #{reviewedBy}, processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, decision_reason = #{rejectionReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE special_rental_requests SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM special_rental_requests WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING'

SELECT id, special_request_id, original_filename, stored_filename, file_path, file_size, file_type, description, created_at FROM special_rental_attachments WHERE special_request_id = #{requestId} ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT l.id, l.special_request_id, l.action_type, l.action_by, l.action_reason, l.previous_status, l.new_status, l.created_at, u.name as action_by_name, u.username as action_by_username FROM special_rental_logs l LEFT JOIN users u ON l.action_by = u.id WHERE l.special_request_id = #{requestId} ORDER BY l.created_at DESC
